title: Particula measurement processing recipe
description: An ordered sequence of versioned operations from a caller-provided registry. Time alignment, units and parameter schemas are declared by each operation.

recipe_version.description: Major version of the recipe contract.

result.description: Output alias of the final step.

inputs.description: Map each physical role to an external input or preceding step.

output.description: New alias for the step's product.

parameters.description: Operation parameters, including an effective-dated calibration reference when required.
